mappings.assertion: TestS1SizeGuard fails for a stale ratchet key and for any function over 100 lines or file over 800: the wt_merge.go file key and the mergeWorktree and reconcileMergedWithOptionalAuthority keys are removed. mergeWorktree is an orchestration over one private mergeInvocation carrier (admit, checkPreconditions, prepare, publish, attribute, validateArtifacts, runIntegrationTests, commitMerged, runPostCommitEffects) in merge_admission.go, merge_preconditions.go, merge_forward.go, merge_failure.go, merge_validation.go and merge_finalize.go; wt_merge.go is 291 lines. The guard runs inside make test at index 0.

TestOracleWtMerge (success W6, conflict W7) and TestOracleReconcileMerged (success W8, refused W9) run live against the delivered goldens, and regen -mode check over ./internal/oracle/a6/... at index 4 reproduces every A6 golden from the starting tree. The new gap case TestOracleWtMergeFailureGaps/tests_failed (gap_merge_failure_test.go, committed with goldens written from the unchanged starting tree before any production edit) freezes the tests-failed outcome through the CLI. HEAD mismatch and post-merge state validation are not deterministic through the CLI determinism layer (short SHAs in their diagnostics; a corrupted artifact ref), so they map to TestMergeWorktree_HEADMismatch in wt_merge_test.go (diagnostic reason and IntegrationFailedError.Reason) and to TestMergeWorktree_RetainsPostMergeArtifactValidationBackstop and the TestMergeWorktree_Rejects*BeforeRefUpdate artifact-guard tests; review-boundary mismatch is not a wt-merge outcome. Disabling the own-merge rollback in runIntegrationTests turned tests_failed red (the merge stayed on the integration branch); restoring it returned green.

The existing merge, preparation, takeover, replay, failure, rollback and reconcile white-box tests in internal/ops are unchanged except for string() conversions of the typed reason, and run in the ops race at index 3. New tests: TestRetireMergedTaskRemovesWorktreeBranchAndPredecessor and TestRetireMergedTaskKeepsWarningTextAndOrder (one retirement helper, unchanged warning text and order), TestRunIntegrationScript (missing, passing, failing and unstattable script), TestPreparationRetirable (the publication flags that gate preparation retirement), TestFillDetectedPostWorktreeCmdIsUnsetOnly (unset-only fill; dropping the nil check turned it red for that reason) and TestIntegrationReasonValuesAndDiagnosticType.

Both C5 time.Now() calls (completion handoff Timestamp and MERGED history Time) sit in the one function recordMergeCompletion called from the final MERGED transaction in commitMerged; recordMergedDeferrals keeps time.Now().UTC() and failure timestamps keep their zone. TestOracleWtMerge/success (both timestamps in its json and state goldens) runs live unchanged, regen check at index 4 reproduces it, and TestRecordMergeCompletionAppendsBothMergeRecords asserts both records and their timestamps.

IntegrationReason is the A6 defined string type: its five constants keep their values (TestIntegrationReasonValuesAndDiagnosticType), IntegrationFailedError.Reason takes it with unchanged Error() text, persisted diagnostics and history convert to plain strings (asserted as string), and review_boundary.go and submission_git_work.go change by string() conversion only. Named values: indexRefreshTriggerMerge, integrationTestWaitDelay, mergeFallbackIntegrationBranch (distinct from the transition-pass default), asserted by TestMergeFlowNamedValues in the ops race at index 3. The A1 and A3 vocabularies (history events, anomaly types, LifecycleEffects) were already adopted and are used as before.

The A6 oracles and every other delivered oracle run live in make test at index 0 against unchanged delivered goldens; git shows no delivered oracle file or golden changed, only the new gap case was added.

The wt_merge.go file key, mergeWorktree and reconcileMergedWithOptionalAuthority keys are removed in this commit; the guard fails on a stale or overrun entry, so TestS1SizeGuard at index 0 proves both.

The test target (go test ./...) runs the ops, archguard and oracle suites at index 0; lint at index 1, test-e2e at index 2, the race run over ops, commands, jsonout and agent at index 3 and the A6 regeneration check at index 4 are mandatory with it.
